name: Christmas Decorators for Production Sets
metaTitle: Christmas Set Decorators for Film & TV, SW Ontario
metaDescription: Christmas light and décor installs for film, TV, and commercial production sets in South-Western Ontario and the GTA. Insured crews, fast strike, flexible dates
h1: Christmas Light and Décor Installation for Film and TV Production
heroIntro: Producers and location managers need holiday dressing that reads right on camera and comes down on schedule. We install and strike Christmas décor around your shoot day, not a season.
intro: Production schedules do not wait for a normal residential install window, and neither do we. Whether you are dressing an exterior location for a holiday scene, wrapping a street or storefront for a commercial shoot, or lighting a backlot property, we work with production designers and location managers to get roofline, tree, and window lighting installed before crew calls and struck the moment the location wraps, sometimes on the same day.

We have supplied lighting for productions filming across London, Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, and the western GTA, all regions with active film and commercial production activity. Our crews carry full insurance and WSIB compliance documentation that production offices typically require before a vendor is approved for a location, and we can quote off a location scout's photos or a production design package rather than an in-person site visit if your timeline is tight.
whatWeInstall: Roofline and building-outline lighting for exterior location shots
Storefront and street-level window lighting for commercial or retail-set scenes
Live and artificial tree wrapping for backyard, street, or backlot exteriors
Interior lit trees and garland for practical set dressing
Wreaths, bows, and entrance décor matched to a production's art direction
Temporary lighting rigs that can be powered independently of house circuits
Colour-matched or era-specific lighting styles on request
Same-day or next-day strike and full removal once filming wraps

whyItPays.heading: Décor That Reads Right on Camera, Not Just in Person
whyItPays.text: Lighting that looks fine to the eye can flicker, buzz, or read wrong through a lens, and a production cannot afford to reshoot a scene because a strand went dark mid-take. We install commercial-grade LED lighting on reliable circuits and can match a specific density, colour temperature, or era-appropriate style to a production designer's brief, so the location holds up across every take and every camera angle.

whyItPays.heading: Insured Work That Clears Production Approval
whyItPays.text: Production offices need proof of insurance and WSIB compliance before approving any vendor near a location, cast, or crew, and we provide that documentation up front. Our crews are used to working around production schedules, base camp logistics, and equipment trucks, and every ladder or lift job is handled by our own insured crew, never a location owner or set dresser.

whyItPays.heading: Fast Turnaround That Matches a Shoot Schedule, Not a Season
whyItPays.text: Productions do not need a display maintained for eight weeks, they need it up before call time and gone by wrap. We quote installs and strikes as standalone jobs on your production timeline rather than a season-long program, and we can turn around a location on short notice when a shoot date moves, which happens often in this business, without holding a production to a residential-style booking calendar.

process: Send location photos, a shot list, or a production design package and your target shoot dates
We quote the install and strike as a standalone job and confirm insurance and WSIB documentation for the production office
Installation is completed ahead of crew call time, matched to the look your production designer specified
We strike the lighting the same day or next day once filming at that location wraps

faq.q: Can you install on a tight production timeline, sometimes with only a few days' notice?
faq.a: We do our best to accommodate short-notice production requests since we understand shoot dates shift constantly. Availability depends on how full our season calendar is at the time, so the earlier a location manager can confirm dates, the more likely we can guarantee the install. Contact us as soon as a location is locked.

faq.q: Do you provide insurance and WSIB documentation for production approval?
faq.a: Yes. We are fully insured and run WSIB-compliant crews, and we can supply certificates of insurance and compliance documentation directly to a production office or line producer ahead of the shoot date, which is typically required before any vendor is approved to work on or near a filming location or cast and crew.

faq.q: Can you match a specific look, colour temperature, or era-appropriate style for a scene?
faq.a: Yes, tell us what the production designer or art department needs, whether that is warm white incandescent-style bulbs for a period piece, a specific colour palette, or a denser or sparser roofline look, and we will source and install lighting that matches the brief rather than a standard residential package.

faq.q: How quickly can you strike the location once filming wraps?
faq.a: Most strikes happen the same day filming wraps or first thing the next morning, depending on crew availability and how quickly the location needs to be returned to the property owner or handed back for the next scene. Confirm your wrap timeline when booking and we will schedule the strike crew accordingly.
